**Presentation**
Troy School District budget presentation, troy.k12.mi.us, dated June 17, 2025, presented by Dan Trudel, CPA. **Taxes levied and Headlee**
The State Education Tax is 6 mills levied on homestead and non-homestead properties, required by the State of Michigan toward the foundation allowance. The Operating Millage is 18 mills levied on non-homestead properties for operating expenditures. Hold Harmless is calculated annually from enrollment, taxable values and the foundation allowance, and is levied on homestead properties. Sinking Fund and Debt Fund millages are levied on both homestead and non-homestead property. The Headlee Amendment, approved by Michigan voters in 1978, automatically rolls back millage rates so taxes do not increase more than the rate of inflation; the district must annually calculate rollbacks to the operating and sinking fund millages.
